Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: W-9 and EIN question for Redwood onboarding

Hi David,

Attaching our completed W-9 for SpringGrove Retail (attached as SpringGrove_W9_2027-05-18.pdf). Finance ran a quick automated match and flagged an EIN/name mismatch versus the IRS lookup — the EIN on the W-9 (XX-XXXXXXX) resolves to our holding company name (SpringGrove Holdings, Inc.). We operate the retail business under the DBA SpringGrove Retail, LLC.

We need to get a PO in place for two upcoming projects (codes RWD-451 and RWD-452) so our procurement team asked if Redwood can create a partial PO while tax validates the W-9. If a bank letter would speed things up, I can attach that too.

Questions:
- Can you confirm what evidence Redwood requires to bridge a DBA/higher-level EIN mapping (W-9 + bank letter? Certificate of DBA?)
- Are you able to issue a provisional/partial PO so we can start work on RWD-451 (smaller milestone) while tax completes the EIN tie-out?

Thanks for the help — looping in procureops in case there are standard docs we should use.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Strategic Procurement
SpringGrove Retail
Attachments: SpringGrove_W9_2027-05-18.pdf
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: W-9 and EIN question for Redwood onboarding

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the W-9.

Short answer: yes, we can proceed with a conditional/partial PO for the smaller milestone (RWD-451) while our tax team completes the EIN reconciliation, but we need one of the following pieces of evidence to clear the vendor record to full PO issuance:

- A bank letter on bank letterhead confirming the legal entity name and EIN, dated within the last 90 days; OR
- A notarized DBA affidavit/Certificate of Assumed Name that explicitly links SpringGrove Retail, LLC to SpringGrove Holdings, Inc.; OR
- A completed SS-4 or tax authority printout showing the EIN assigned to SpringGrove Retail (if available).

If you can provide a bank letter now we will thread that into the tax review and should be able to clear the EIN within 2–3 business days. For the partial PO we can create a one-off provisional PO limited to $25,000 for RWD-451 with the understanding that final PO issuance and invoice routing will be conditional on tax confirmation.

I've CC'd Kimberly (procurement ops) and Marissa (vendor onboarding). Kimberly — can you confirm internal approval path for a $25k provisional PO and if we need a PO memo?

Thanks,
David Kim
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the attachments, team.

Internal note (Marissa): I just reviewed the bank letter. It meets our current evidence checklist (bank name, account holder name matching the DBA plus EIN reference). We can move forward with a provisional PO for $25,000 limited to RWD-451, with these controls:

- PO status: PROVISIONAL (expiration: 30 days)
- Invoice routing: accounts-payable@springgrove.co only; any invoices must include project code RWD-451
- Holdback: final 15% retainer until EIN is fully reconciled and vendor record is updated to the receiving legal entity in our ERP
- Tax follow-up: Tax team will confirm EIN tie-out within 3 business days; if no match, payments beyond the provisional PO will be paused until additional evidence (notarized DBA or SS-4) is provided

Elena/procureops — can you confirm acceptance of the above controls? If yes, David and I will create the provisional PO and route the PO memo through Procurement for approval.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
